text:
priyanka: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we observed two recurring patterns: (1) services without audit-log hooks enabled and (2) a handful of long-lived service tokens that weren't on the rotation schedule. Starting this thread to track owners + short timelines.

olivia: thanks. can we get a concise list of action items?

priyanka: Yep — initial split: 
  - token-sweep and emergency rotation script (owner @priyanka) — prototype by Wed, deploy to staging Thurs.
  - audit-log enforcement as infra policy (owner @navid) — admission webhook to reject deploys missing audit annotation, PR by Tue.
  - add ci/regression test that fails when any service lacks audit annotation (owner @esther) — target Fri.
  - secrets lifecycle RFC + scheduled audit job (owner @matt) — draft in 2 weeks.

sam: sounds good. for rotation script, what's the manual fallback if something breaks?

priyanka: Fallback plan: manual rotation runbook + oncall escalation. I'll document steps in Ops Runbook page and tag the rotation responder team. @olivia can you own the ops doc + contact list?

olivia: yes, happy to. I'll add the manual commands and a checklist.

navid: I'm going to scope the admission webhook to services in prod namespaces first. Need inventory of services that use service tokens — @priyanka can you post that?

priyanka: Inventory is uploaded: https://internal.redwood/inventory/service-tokens-2024-06-14.csv. Quick grep command I used to generate it: 
```
kubectl get secrets -A -l type=service-token -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name}{"|"}{.metadata.annotations.service}{"\n"}{end}'
```

esther: I'll wire a CI check that queries that inventory and fails the pipeline if any deployed manifest lacks the audit annotation. Also adding an automated smoke test that calls token-introspect + asserts expected response codes.

matt: For the RFC: thinking about mandatory 90-day rotation and discovery scans every 7 days. Will include exceptions for legacy services and a migration plan.

sec-bot: security: Created ticket SEC-1002: "Token sweep + audit-hook enforcement". Link: https://tracker.redwood/sec/1002. Priority: P2.

infra-bot: deploybot: Staged rollout scheduled — admission webhook canary to dev at 2024-07-22T03:00Z.

sam: can we add a short metric so we can track recurrence? maybe percent of services with audit-hook + count of tokens rotated per week.

priyanka: good call. I'll add telemetry events for rotation success/failure and a dashboard for audit-hook coverage.

olivia: reminder — short sync Fri 9:30am PT to confirm PRs + runbook. please post blockers here if you can't make it.

priyanka: PR opened for rotation script: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/rotator/pull/7 (wip). requesting review from @esther and @navid.

esther: reviewing now. quick note: mock introspection endpoint and include an integration test. Also confirm token deletion is safe when service reports active sessions.

navid: PR for admission webhook coming soon — will include exception list for infra-managed services.

matt: RFC draft posted to docs: https://docs.redwood/rfcs/secret-lifecycle-2024.md — feedback welcome.

sam: marked owners in remediation board and set weekly reminders. thanks all :thumbsup:
